---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity Group Comparison analyses"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Group comparisons of claustrum connectivity between preterm- (VP/VLBW) and full-term-born adults (BLS cohort). ANCOVA per target ROI (connectivity \~ group + age at scan + sex), FDR correction across the 22 target ROIs.

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv` (ComBat-harmonized CP and CD per target ROI, demographics)
- Outputs (`outputs/tables`):
  - `GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_NEW_<date>.csv`: CP, full sample (results/groupcomp_CP_ANCOVA_BLS.csv)
  - `GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_noICB_NEW<date>.csv`: CP, participants with perinatal IVH excluded (results/groupcomp_CP_ANCOVA_BLS_IVH_excluded.csv)
  - `GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_excl_NEW<date>.csv`: CP, outlier values excluded (results/groupcomp_CP_ANCOVA_BLS_outliers_excluded.csv)
  - `GroupComparison_CD_FTvsPT_TypeIII_NEW<date>.csv`: CD, full sample (results/groupcomp_CD_ANCOVA_BLS.csv)

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(car)
library(emmeans)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),

    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

## Create subsets

```{r}
drop_vars <- c("id")

final_dat_CP <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cd_"), -all_of(drop_vars))

final_dat_CD <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cp_"), -all_of(drop_vars))

# control analysis: participants with perinatal IVH excluded
final_dat_CP_noICB <- final_dat_CP %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(hemo) | hemo == 0)
```

# Specific Setup

```{r}
# sum-to-zero contrasts for Type III tests
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

stopifnot(is.factor(final_dat_CP$group), is.factor(final_dat_CP$sex))
```

# ANCOVA function

```{r}
cp_vars <- grep("^cp_", names(final_dat_CP), value = TRUE)
cd_vars <- grep("^cd_", names(final_dat_CD), value = TRUE)

run_ancova <- function(dv, data, labels = roi_labels){
  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~ group + age_at_scan + sex"))
  df  <- data[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 20) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)

  # Type III ANOVA
  a3  <- car::Anova(fit, type = 3)

  a3_df <- as.data.frame(a3)
  a3_df$Term <- rownames(a3_df)

  ss_group <- a3_df$`Sum Sq`[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  df_group <- a3_df$Df[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  Fval     <- a3_df$`F value`[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  pval     <- a3_df$`Pr(>F)`[a3_df$Term == "group"]

  ss_res   <- a3_df$`Sum Sq`[a3_df$Term == "Residuals"]
  df_res   <- a3_df$Df[a3_df$Term == "Residuals"]

  partial_eta2 <- as.numeric(ss_group / (ss_group + ss_res))

  # estimated marginal means and contrast (FT - PT)
  emm   <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group)
  comp  <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "pairwise") %>% summary(infer = TRUE)

  emm_tbl <- as.data.frame(emm)
  mean_FT <- emm_tbl$emmean[emm_tbl$group == "FT"]
  mean_PT <- emm_tbl$emmean[emm_tbl$group == "PT"]
  diff_FT_PT <- comp$estimate[1]

  dir_lab <- if (pval < 0.05) {
    if (diff_FT_PT > 0) "FT > PT" else "PT > FT"
  } else {
    if (diff_FT_PT > 0) "NS (FT > PT)" else "NS (PT > FT)"
  }

  f_str <- sprintf("F(1, %d) = %.2f, p = %s",
                   df_res, Fval,
                   ifelse(pval < .001, "< 0.001**",
                          ifelse(pval < .01, sprintf("%.3f*", pval),
                                 sprintf("%.3f", pval))))

  tibble(
    dv            = dv,
    ROI           = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!labels, .default = dv),
    N             = nrow(df),
    F             = as.numeric(Fval),
    df1           = as.numeric(df_group),
    df2           = as.numeric(df_res),
    p             = as.numeric(pval),
    partial_eta2  = partial_eta2,
    emmean_FT     = as.numeric(mean_FT),
    emmean_PT     = as.numeric(mean_PT),
    diff_FT_minus_PT = as.numeric(diff_FT_PT),
    Direction     = dir_lab,
    F_string      = f_str
  )
}
```

# ANCOVA CP, full sample

```{r}
res_group <- map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova, data = final_dat_CP)

# FDR across ROIs
res_group <- res_group %>%
  mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p, p_FDR)

outfile <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_NEW_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
readr::write_csv2(res_group, outfile)
message("Saved: ", outfile)
```

# Control analysis: outlier values excluded

Single outlier values (outside 1.5 x IQR per ROI) are set to missing; no participants are removed entirely.

```{r}
if (!exists("long_cp")) {
  long_cp <- final_dat_CP %>%
    dplyr::select(subject, group, sex, age_at_scan, scanner_id, dplyr::starts_with("cp_")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::starts_with("cp_"),
                        names_to = "roi_code", values_to = "connectivity") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(roi = factor(roi_code, levels = names(roi_labels), labels = roi_labels))
}

stopifnot(all(c("subject","roi_code","roi","connectivity") %in% names(long_cp)))

long_cp_outliers <- long_cp %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, roi_code, roi, value = connectivity)

cp_stats <- long_cp_outliers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    q1     = stats::quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3     = stats::quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr    = q3 - q1,
    lower  = q1 - 1.5 * iqr,
    upper  = q3 + 1.5 * iqr,
    mean   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
final_dat_CP_excl <- final_dat_CP

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cp_stats))) {
  roi_var <- cp_stats$roi_code[i]
  lower   <- cp_stats$lower[i]
  upper   <- cp_stats$upper[i]

  final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]] <- ifelse(
    final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]] < lower | final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]] > upper,
    NA,
    final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]]
  )
}

# number of values set to missing
sum(is.na(final_dat_CP_excl)) - sum(is.na(final_dat_CP))
```

```{r}
res_group_excl <- map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova, data = final_dat_CP_excl)

# FDR across ROIs
res_group_excl <- res_group_excl %>%
  mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p, p_FDR)

outfile <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_excl_NEW", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
readr::write_csv2(res_group_excl, outfile)
message("Saved: ", outfile)
```
